vocanacompat.emi.imbue.none.title: No imbue recipes are known here
vocanacompat.emi.imbue.none.text: The Imbue Bench's recipes live on the server. In single player they show here; on a dedicated server, install Vocana Compat with EMI on the server too and it sends them to you when you join.
vocanacompat.emi.ritual.figure.title: The ritual figure
vocanacompat.emi.ritual.figure.text: Stand inside a closed ring of anchors (amethyst, lodestone, copper, soul soil, candles: the vocana:ritual_anchors tag): at least three, set two to four and a half blocks out, around at least three quarters of the circle, with one cardinal way out left clear.
vocanacompat.emi.ritual.figure.text2: Each anchor adds 8 Capacity and takes 5% off Strain gain, up to ten. The Working becomes Ritual tier (up to 250 CP) and may use the Ritual-only laws the server allows; a release inside the figure counts double as practice.
vocanacompat.emi.ritual.channel.title: Channelling at the bench
vocanacompat.emi.ritual.channel.text: A recipe may ask for catalyst blocks within reach of the bench (the shipped chant recipe wants four anchors within five) and for a channel. Then Imbue lays nothing yet: the bench glows and waits (60 seconds by default).
vocanacompat.emi.ritual.channel.text2: Perform the chant within reach: the chant itself for a chant imbue, or a Working of the essence with IMBUE for an essence. At the Seal it is captured into the gear instead of released, and the price is charged then. Cancel, or the wait running out, lets the bench rest.
vocanacompat.emi.ritual.strip.title: Stripping an imbue
vocanacompat.emi.ritual.strip.text: Lay an imbued piece on the bench and press Strip: one chosen imbue, or all of them, for %s experience levels each by default (bench.stripXp).
vocanacompat.emi.ritual.strip.text2: An essence leaves an Essence Residue carrying it and half the recipe's materials come back (bench.stripRefund). A residue laid in the bench makes that essence cheaper to lay again (the vocana:residue recipe).
vocanacompat.emi.lexicon.no_snapshot: Open the Tuning Chime or your Grimoire once; these pages then show what you have heard.
vocanacompat.emi.lexicon.unheard: An unheard form. Listen with the Tuning Chime near what it names.
vocanacompat.emi.lexicon.unheard_deep: An unheard deep word: it answers only below the world's floor, in the Nether or the End, or from a Whispering Relic.
vocanacompat.emi.lexicon.unheard_grammar: An unheard word of the grammar: it answers to counts, triggers and names in the world, and Whispering Relics carry it.
vocanacompat.emi.lexicon.unheard_prime: A blank line. Primes are Borne, not heard.
vocanacompat.emi.lexicon.unheard_calling: An empty name not yet surfaced. Master a chant and one rises.
vocanacompat.emi.lexicon.elder: Elder word: a shade of %s, borrowed from an older tongue%s.
vocanacompat.emi.lexicon.elder_unheard_b: a word you have not heard
vocanacompat.emi.proficiency.title: Proficiency (%s releases master a chant here)
vocanacompat.emi.proficiency.gains: A release by voice counts more, one sealed inside a ritual figure more still (server settings). A mastered chant can be bound to a Calling.
